title: Associate Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Purpose of Position

Our Product Team is looking for a passionate and dedicated colleague to join them and build world-class products to move the performance marketing industry forward.

In this role, you will work closely with both internal and external developers to build plugins, connectors and other integrations including with e-commerce and customer data platforms. You will support the product backlog management and ensure that our products meet customer needs and business objectives.

This is an exciting role where you will build and maintain a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape and industry trends. 

If you care about delivering products that customers love, enjoy working with different cultures, and meeting people from around the world, this position is a great opportunity for you. Join our team at our Product Hubs in Berlin, London, Amsterdam or Milan, or work from another country where Awin has an office.

 

What you'll be responsible for:

  • In this role, you will collaborate with product managers to manage the backlog.
  • You will liaise between internal and external engineers, the UX team, and stakeholders to ensure clear communication of product requirements.
  • You will monitor product performance metrics and generate reports to support data-driven decision making.
  • You will partner with customer-facing teams to gather customer feedback and insights, and use that feedback to inform product development decisions
  • You will identify opportunities with product peers to further add value to our plugins and various platform integrations
  • You will work with the Product Marketing team to communicate releases and drive adoption of existing and new products
  • You will develop and maintain a deep understanding of the e-commerce, customer-data platform landscape, and industry trends…

title: Mid Market Account Executive - France (f/m/d)
description:

As a Mid-Market Account Executive (f/m/d), you’ll drive Contentful’s growth by leading the end-to-end sales process with our top-tier clients. You’ll be instrumental in driving adoption and engagement, finding new revenue opportunities, and creating customer enablement initiatives within a few named accounts.  You’ll work closely with our partnership and customer success team to lead a consultative sales process by speaking to professional developers and business leaders in the France market.

What To Expect?

  • Self-generation of the pipeline through outbound motions in conjunction with marketing and BDR teams to help create new opportunities in regional accounts
  • Drive expansion opportunities with existing clients in the French territory.
  • Grow existing accounts by leveraging relationships and following our comprehensive “land and expand” sales model
  • Meet quarterly and annual sales goals by developing an account strategy and pipeline, managing internal and client processes, maintaining sales reports, developing market and competitor knowledge, delivering presentations to customers, and creating sales proposals

title: Senior Manager, Australia Communications
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is building technology for the defence challenges of today and tomorrow. In Australia, that means working with the ADF, industry and partners to develop and deliver capabilities that can make a difference in the defence of our nation.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Communications to help tell that story. You will turn complex programs and technology into clear, credible communications for Australian audiences. You will lead media engagement, develop narratives around our work, support senior leaders and help the team communicate through major milestones and fast-moving issues.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set direction, write exceptionally well and deliver at pace. You will work across the Australian business and with colleagues internationally, balancing long-term reputation building with the demands of a busy news cycle.

The Australian business is growing rapidly, with over 300 employees, so this role will also support our internal comms work, engaging our employees and making sure our people are bought into the mission.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and execute communications plans that support Anduril’s priorities in Australia.
